design_references.title: Deterministic distiller extension
design_references.claim: Section 9 URL extraction extension: deterministic source fidelity and process cost.

hypothesis: Distiller produces valid readable EPUBs retaining the selected source text, chapter structure and raster figures more completely than xberg extraction plus Pandoc.
null_hypothesis: Distiller loses a declared component or cannot produce a readable EPUB, preventing a superiority claim.
independent_variable: Conversion pipeline on the same frozen HTML/PDF bytes.

environment.network_justification: Shared acquisition of public HTML assets before pipeline execution; variants use identical offline HTML and local PDF. No credentials or model calls.

variants.name: distiller
variants.description: Installed optimized deterministic Rust CLI, including native PDFium worker. HTML uses the recorded original base URL.

config.input_adapter: Shared offline HTML preparation: resolve links against original URL, fetch each image once, losslessly convert WebP to PNG, replace src with matching local image path and remove srcset. No content selection/removal. PDF copied unchanged.
config.packaging: xberg output and direct HTML use Pandoc EPUB3 with TOC, depth6, preserved tabs and supplied source title/language. No PDF preprocessor is supplied to direct Pandoc; its unsupported-input terminal is recorded.

variants.name: xberg-pandoc
variants.description: Installed xberg extraction with raster-image extraction enabled, followed by Pandoc EPUB3 with TOC; no OCR/cache/models/config discovery.

config.input_adapter: Shared offline HTML preparation: resolve links against original URL, fetch each image once, losslessly convert WebP to PNG, replace src with matching local image path and remove srcset. No content selection/removal. PDF copied unchanged.
config.packaging: xberg output and direct HTML use Pandoc EPUB3 with TOC, depth6, preserved tabs and supplied source title/language. No PDF preprocessor is supplied to direct Pandoc; its unsupported-input terminal is recorded.

variants.name: pandoc
variants.description: Direct HTML-to-EPUB3; PDF input unsupported and reported as such.

randomness.justification: Two user-selected sources, descriptive case study. Frozen HTML/PDF inputs; image bytes cached once for identical inputs across pipelines and digested. Prior developmental output inspected; no held-out claim.

metrics.primary: Successful EPUB creation and independent EPUBCheck errors, separated from source fidelity.
secondary: Source text and selected reading-order sentences
Source versus EPUB raster image count
Blog article headings/navigation and chrome contamination
Original PDF bookmark links and exact source-page destinations
metrics.acceptance_rule: No overall score. No superiority claim if any declared important component is lost or reading-system display is unchecked. Report component tradeoffs, failures and selection bias.

evaluator.rubric: Inspect source DOM and PDF metadata/layout; inspect generated ZIP/XHTML source text, headings, images, source-page anchors, selected drop-cap/body/note sentences. Run EPUBCheck 5.4.0. Scanned PDF, vector graphics, semantic equation reconstruction and reading-device acceptance remain explicitly unverified. Prior exploratory substrate probes are known; no held-out generalization. Compare original bookmark labels/destinations separately from printed heading reconstruction. Generated covers are checked separately from source-fidelity runs. Reader smoke checks sample article prose/diagrams/lists and PDF navigation/prose/figures/notes; they do not imply full-book acceptance.
